thread:
sam: Hey folks, running into an onboarding hiccup. I cloned the starter, set REDWOOD_API_KEY from the welcome email and started the app. Browser console shows WebSocket connected and the UI enables the chat input for ~1s, then the message send fails with a 402 Payment Required. The console in the dashboard shows the workspace state as 'Pending billing'. Has anyone seen the socket appear ready while REST calls are blocked by billing?

alana: @sam yea, that pattern has popped up in workshops. Usually billing gating prevents token usage until a payment method is added or invite accepted. The odd part is the WS "connected" state. Can you paste the exact response from the failing request?

sam: Copied from network tab:
```json
{
  "error": "billing_required",
  "message": "Workspace billing not configured: first call blocked"
}
```
App UI briefly shows the composer enabled then displays a toast error.

jess: Sounds like the client shows a quick optimistic 'connected' after the socket handshake, but the server still does a stricter check on REST calls. People assume 'connected' means everything is good which is misleading. We saw a similar UX bug last week.

marco: Two quick checks: is the key a personal trial key or the workspace welcome key? If the org hasn't accepted billing, workspace-scoped keys sometimes get blocked for API usage while lightweight socket handshakes succeed. `redwood whoami` should show org status.

sam: `redwood whoami` output shows: "org: acme-co (pending)". So looks like invite/billing state is the cause.

deploy-bot: :information_source: deploy 29901: console feature flag enabled to show explicit 'Billing required' banner for pending orgs.

alana: Short-term workarounds: 1) Add a payment method to the org; 2) accept the invite to the workspace from the account that received the welcome email; 3) create a fresh workspace for the workshop if faster. Longer term we should fix the quickstart to check org state before enabling the UI. I'll file a DX doc and ticket.

jess: Filed DEVX-618: "quickstart: validate org billing state on client boot". Proposed client change: on startup call GET /v1/org and if state !== "active" show an overlay with steps (accept invite / add payment) instead of enabling the composer. Added repro steps and screenshot.

sam: That overlay would have saved 20 minutes in the workshop. I'll PR a patch to the starter repo to add the org-state check and to avoid showing the chat UI until validation passes.

jess: Thanks—also added a one-line note in the starter README about checking the console for 'Pending billing' and verifying invite acceptance.

marco: Infra follow-up: unify auth gating so websocket handshake and REST token checks use the same org-state policy. We should avoid any false-positive 'connected' state. I'll open an infra ticket to align the middleware.

alana: Also going to add a tiny telemetry event to capture "ws_connected_but_firstcall_fails" occurrences so we can quantify how common this is in onboarding flows.

sam: Uploaded patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter/pull/47 (adds org-state check + overlay) :rocket: Will test after merge. Thanks! :thumbsup:
